scenes.narration: MasjidOne is one system that brings together a masjid's madrasah and its congregation.

scenes.on_screen: Many masājid run their week across several tools that…
scenes.narration: Many masājid run their week across several tools that do not talk to each other.
Every masjid gets four surfaces: a website, in-masjid screens, a congregation app and a madrasah portal, in its own colours and on its own domain.

scenes.on_screen: The madrasah portal holds the masjid's roll
scenes.narration: The madrasah portal holds the masjid's roll, classes, staff and households, with registers and fees configured.

scenes.on_screen: MasjidOne runs the madrasah's daily operations
scenes.narration: MasjidOne runs the madrasah's daily operations — the register, the sabaq heard and the fee due — in the same system as the congregation side.
